choices.label: Step through (take up another class; your class levels start over)
choices.resultText: The glass gives like water. On the far side your weight sits differently, and the old name will not come.

choices.label: Turn away
choices.resultText: The figure in the glass turns away too, a moment after you do.

choices.label: Offer a card (lose a random card, take 6 damage)
choices.resultText: The card crumbles to gold leaf in its palm. Its other hand closes around yours — the blessing is not gentle.

choices.label: Pray (heal 20% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Warmth knits your wounds shut. Something else follows you out of the clearing.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The hand stays open behind you for a long time.

choices.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders; the owners may object)
choices.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Not every gift is free. You keep walking.

choices.label: Give 50 cinders (gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: She presses the bundle into your hands and walks into the rain without counting.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: She nods, as if she expected nothing else.

choices.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
choices.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The altar does not care. It has waited longer than you.

choices.label: The procedure (remove a random card, take 4 damage)
choices.resultText: He holds something up to the light, nods, and does not let you see it.

choices.label: The patch (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: Competent, quick, and strangely cold. He refuses payment.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Suit yourself. The spire will finish what I would have started."

choices.label: Gather the falling cinders (gain 40 cinders)
choices.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

choices.label: Sit with it a while (heal 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: You keep the vigil. When you rise, some of its lightness has passed to you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some deaths are not yours to attend.

choices.label: Take the offering (gain a random relic — its keeper objects)
choices.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Wild ember keeps its own accounts. You leave the ledger closed.

choices.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
choices.resultText: The script rearranges something behind your eyes. You are sharper, and less.

choices.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

choices.label: Dig for cinders (gain 90 cinders; the grave may wake)
choices.resultText: The cinders come loose in cold handfuls. Somewhere under the swords, something shifts its weight.

choices.label: Pay respects (heal 15% max HP)
choices.resultText: You right a fallen blade and stand a while. When you leave, you are lighter than you came.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the broken swords where they lie. No name is written here.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

choices.label: Enter the ring (fight the soldier for 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: You step across the stone line. The soldier finally moves.

choices.label: Circle it instead (lose 5% max HP crossing the rubble, gain 20 cinders)
choices.resultText: The rubble takes its toll, but the ring — and whatever waits in it — stays quiet.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some rings are drawn for a reason. You leave this one closed.

choices.label: Take it with you (gain a Guilt curse; the pack has 45 cinders)
choices.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

choices.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders; leave the card)
choices.resultText: The provisions catch fast. The face-down card curls to ash before you can read it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the pack and do not look back.

choices.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

choices.label: Shatter the altar (fight what wakes, gain 70 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone face cracks down the middle. What answers the noise is not stone at all.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The many eyes stay open behind you, patient as ever.

choices.label: Accept the blessing (gain a random relic; lose 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: His hand closes over yours. The reliquary is warm, and the warmth does not stop where your skin does.

choices.label: Rob him (gain 50 cinders; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: He does not resist. He only smiles wider, as if you have taken exactly what he meant you to.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "The Blight is patient," he calls after you. "It will keep your seat."

choices.label: Snatch the strongbox (gain 80 cinders; they may wake)
choices.resultText: The box comes free with a wet scrape. All around you, fingers go still — then flex.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.resultText: You retrace your steps one careful footfall at a time. The nest never stirs.

choices.label: Warm yourself (heal 18% max HP)
choices.resultText: The last of the light soaks into you. When it fades, the ground is only ground.

choices.label: Temper a blade (upgrade a random card, lose 6% max HP)
choices.resultText: You hold a card to the dying ember until it takes the edge. It costs you something to keep the flame that long.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let the ember fade unspent. Some kindnesses are not yours to take.

choices.label: Pay in kind (give 60 cinders, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The cinders vanish from your hand into a ledger that isn't there. The relic is very solid, and very cold.

choices.label: Take it and run (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: It does not chase you. It only watches, and writes something down, and the writing follows you out.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Come again," it says, to no one, already forgetting you.

choices.label: Go for the hoard (gain 100 cinders; it will almost certainly wake)
choices.resultText: Your hands fill with cold light. Behind you, the breathing stops.

choices.label: Skim the edges (squeeze past the rubble, lose 5% max HP, gain 25 cinders)
choices.resultText: You take only what is within reach and pay for it in scraped ribs. The den keeps its heart.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some fortunes are guarded by teeth. You leave this one to its keeper.

choices.label: Give what it asks (remove a random card, lose 8% max HP, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The stake drinks a card and a breath of your strength, and hands back something older than either.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the thorn. It hums after you, patient, certain you'll be back.

choices.label: Sharpen (upgrade 2 random cards, take 5 damage)
choices.resultText: The rhythm settles behind your eyes. Two of your cards come back keener; your hands ache with the knowing.

choices.label: Mend (heal 22% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Warmth floods you, generous and total. Something reads back through the water, and does not look away.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The fingers tap on. You leave the riddle unanswered, which is its own kind of answer.

choices.label: Return what you took (lose 90 cinders; the keeper stands down)
choices.resultText: The cinders go back into the lantern one by one. The keeper turns without a word and walks the way you came.

choices.label: Stand your ground (fight; keep what you took)
choices.resultText: The keeper turns away, the lantern dimming along the road. The figures following it stop in front of you and draw their weapons.

choices.label: Accept the keeper's thanks (gain the Gravetender's Bell)
choices.resultText: A small bell, iron and cold, pressed into your palm. "One toll for each name," the keeper says. "You will know when."

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

choices.label: Raise every sword and keep the vigil (upgrade 2 random cards)
choices.resultText: You raise every fallen sword and stand among them until the cinder-light gutters. The bell in your pack rings once, though nothing moved it. The stones remain unwritten.

choices.label: Raise every sword, then rest (heal 30% max HP)
choices.resultText: You set every sword upright before lying down among the stones. What you returned bought you this much: a night among the nameless, and no one waking you.

choices.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You drag the fallen swords aside and prise the cinders from beneath them. Second time is easier. You leave the blades in the mud; that is the part that follows you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

choices.label: Buy signal oil (pay 40 cinders; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The wick catches. The Road Warden records forty cinders beside Lantern Haven in a weathered supply ledger.

choices.label: Haul the beacon (take 8 damage; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The iron frame cuts your palms, but its light clears the ridge. The Road Warden waves Lantern Haven’s wagons through and promises to remember the work.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You pass the unlit lantern. The caravan must find another way.

choices.label: Accept the quartermaster’s lesson (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The quartermaster shows you the economy of a practiced motion. Your investment returns as knowledge.

choices.label: Accept wages for the climb (gain 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: The Road Warden counts out fair wages. The cuts on your hands have earned their keep.

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.
